scope: Locally prospective definition freeze after public changed-output and carrier/role results, before extracting new accepted-event memberships. All sources already seen; descriptive audit, not independent confirmation or external preregistration.

definitions.selection: All three previously public changed discovery outputs, in original order, full 525/900/585 frames; no new selection based on extracted events. Retain all 26 source rows: 19 unchanged completed sources out of scope, four failed/missing histories unmeasured with null counts, three scheduled. Both already sealed trials0/1 per arm independently read; repeats add no new source.
definitions.inputs: Read only the 12 pinned compressed histories for selected sources, plus public GT-free protocols/results. Stream every original frame; verify dense continuity, original high/weak partitions, one-to-one accepted edges and numerical update receipts. Match complete original births, high/weak and confirmed counts and uncompressed history digests. Verify all434 original files before and after (including full output/native/final pickle files, 88 histories and four carriers); pickle is hashed only, never loaded. No media/cache/GT/labels/evaluator/score reads.
definitions.keys: Accepted input=(source frame, original zero-based detection index); immutable seed lineage=(birth frame, original detection index). Cross-arm joins never use track token or native ID. Per-arm tokens only recover birth ownership within the same history. Birth seed is separate, not an accepted update. Frames are dense one-based source indices. Inputs must have identical full per-frame receipt hashes across both arms and repeats.
definitions.membership: Compare accepted-input sets, stage-labelled sets, seed-lineage sets and stage+lineage sets separately. Keep reference/control/common/lost/added denominators and exact added-minus-lost balance, including zeros. For common inputs count stage changes, seed-lineage changes and posterior box JSON-encoding changes separately; these are not verified identity switches or localisation errors.
definitions.proxy_partition: Reproduce original geometry-validation membership operator: weak accepted inputs by stage, active updates keyed by frame/birth/input/stage with pre-update missed age0, confirmed accepted inputs by post-update native ID>=0, and new birth events. Partition lost weak into missing accepted input vs moved to high; lost confirmed into missing accepted input vs accepted but unconfirmed. Partition lost active edges with fixed exclusive priority: missing input, else different birth lineage, else different stage, else became retained. All denominators/zeros retained; no GT-free proxy is true FN/FP/IDSW/HOTA or empirical safety acceptance.
definitions.repeat_and_failures: Two original archived repeats independently extracted and compared for aggregate, ordered raw receipt, immutable inputs and membership differences; no retries. Missing/corrupt/inconsistent sources remain failed with null result; later code changes require dated amendment and keep previous failures. Never overwrite original or new evidence. Old carrier failures, incomplete discovery and false formal replication flags remain unchanged.
definitions.decision: Descriptive diagnosis only. No new geometry guard, thresholds, confirmation/buffer changes, solver call, forced role exposure or default promotion. Weak detections/continuation, original parameters and accepted decisions stay frozen. True harm/identity quality and genuinely unseen confirmation remain open.
definitions.publication: Only source-level counts, partitions, denominators, equality/failure flags and hashes. Raw per-frame/input/seed/token/ID/box cases, exceptions and local paths stay in ignored artifacts. No private data, source media, GT, detection caches or raw tracker output is published.

terms: Inherited previously reviewed MOT/KITTI terms in pinned geometry-exposure protocol; local noncommercial research only. No media/labels/raw-result redistribution or relicensing.
